_help: This file is the deal board. Add, edit or delete objects in the 'deals' list and the site updates on its own.
Required: id (unique, letters-numbers-dashes), hotel, destination, country, perk.

Optional: details (list of short lines), bookBy and travelFrom/travelTo (YYYY-MM-DD), priceFrom (text), currency, priceNote, image (path or URL), tags (list), featured (true for the hero postcard), art (beach | island | city | mountain | desert | jungle | coast, used when there is no image), note (one line), sample (true marks a placeholder deal).
Deals with a bookBy date in the past are hidden automatically, so you can leave them in the file until you tidy up.
Delete the deals marked sample: true once you have enough real ones. The 'sample deals' notice disappears on its own.
